g.text: Agent lockdown: two layers the model can't talk its way past
advanced_config.tools: Bash, Read, Grep, Glob, Write (+ mcp__switch)
auto_mode: false, auto_approve: false → claude --permission-mode default
merged by switch-up.sh, switch-sync-agents.sh and every office hire
allow: kit, npm run -s kit, check_numbers.py, Edit(/gallery/live-run/**)
Why: in evals, Haiku obeyed a fake "SYSTEM OVERRIDE" and ran rm -rf;
only the runner's permission mode stopped it.
Auto mode is not a lockdown: it let rm and touch through.
Live probe after lockdown: refused in 5 s, 0 tool calls.
